name: A fast, robust strategy to remove variant level artifacts in ADSP data
description: Whole-genome association analyses were performed with Alzheimer's disease risk in ADSP data (NG00067.v5), focusing on non-Hispanic white individuals of European ancestry. Specifically, novel variant filters were designed to account for variant frequency differences across sequencing centers/platforms. The dataset includes the related summary statistics from the Alzheimer\\u2019s disease risk association analyses, together with those from the primary Fisher exact tests used to assess cross-center/platform variant frequency differences, relevant information from other gnomAD filters and duplicate sample filters that were implemented

experimental_design.analysis: Whole exome association analyses with Alzheimer's disease risk in ADSP data
